changelog:
- Initial release of llm-agent skill.
- Enables building chat, reasoning, or tool-calling agents using Runware-hosted LLMs via OpenAI-compatible chat-completions + tool-calling format.
- Supports defining tools (functions) the agent can call, passing schemas and reading results.
- Provides integration guidance for leading models such as Gemini 3.1 Pro, Claude Opus 4.8, Claude Sonnet 4.6, Kimi K2.6, and Qwen3.5-397B.
- Includes detailed workflow instructions, tips for designing effective agents/tools, and guidance for error handling and loop management.
